package.description: Real-time AI-powered fact-checking with credibility scores, claim detection, source analysis, and misinformation alerts.

en-US.description: Real-time AI-powered fact-checking with credibility scores, claim detection, source analysis, and misinformation alerts.
en-US.longDescription:
FactChecker Pro is a Windows desktop companion app that brings AI-powered fact-checking
to your daily browsing. It connects with the FactChecker Pro Chrome extension to deliver
real-time credibility scores, claim detection, source analysis, and misinformation alerts.

Sign in to access your transparency score, review your fact-checking history, manage account
settings, and receive live notifications when claims on pages you visit are flagged.

Requires the FactChecker Pro Chrome extension for full functionality.
en-US.name: FactChecker Pro
